# Data Pulse Social

> Data Pulse Social is a curriculum development and educational content company that partners with educators, institutions, and organizations to design comprehensive learning experiences — from course frameworks and assessments to multimedia content and LMS integration.

## About

Data Pulse Social specializes in end-to-end instructional design services. Founded in 2020, the company helps clients transform subject-matter expertise into structured, engaging, and outcomes-driven educational programs.

## Services

- **Curriculum Development** — Standards-aligned course frameworks, learning objectives, and program architecture
- **Course Content Creation** — Lesson materials, reading packs, slide decks, and written content
- **Assessment Design** — Quizzes, rubrics, project briefs, and competency evaluations
- **Multimedia Content** — Video scripts, audio narration, and interactive media production
- **LMS Integration** — SCORM-ready packaging and deployment into learning management systems
- **Training & Support** — Instructor onboarding, facilitator guides, and ongoing content maintenance

## Pricing

Monthly subscription plans:

- Basic — $41/month (single course, up to 10 modules, basic assessments, 2 revision rounds, email support)
- Professional — $108/month (full curriculum design, up to 30 modules, advanced assessments, unlimited revisions, multimedia content, priority support)
- Enterprise — $250/month (multi-program development, unlimited modules, custom branding, LMS integration, training workshops, dedicated account manager)

Payments are processed securely via Stripe.
